answer_1.quote: We pair each extracted anomalous image with annotations supporting three open-ended tasks ... anomaly description, anomaly explanation, and anomaly justification.
answer_1.outputs: textual descriptions, explanations, and justifications of visual anomalies

answer_2.quote: We employ GPT-4o as a judge to assess whether two descriptions refer to the same anomaly ... We compute the precision, recall, and F1-score using these counts.

answer_3.quote: We employ GPT-4o as a judge to assess whether two descriptions refer to the same anomaly ... Claude-3.5 was used to score outputs from both GPT-4o and the top-performing open-source model.

answer_4.quote: Due to the subjectivity of these criteria, we rely entirely on human evaluation. Three annotators compare each model-generated justification with the human one and rate it as better, similar or worse.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare model-generated justifications against human justifications and assign a rating of better, similar, or worse.
